title: Plural / Collective Encounter
architecture_reference: SILT Core v0.2 Semantic Architecture - Freeze Candidate 1 (derived from RC4.1 pre-freeze stress-test revision)
purpose: Test whether different normative orders can become mutually legible at a single encounter while remaining distinct.
pressure_test: Conflicting Profile Expressions, contested provenance, collective Standing, representational Authority and deliberate non-expression.

encounter.context: P Presents relational Standing and claimed Authority from Collective C to Institution R. PE-C and PE-R impose different encounter conditions.

sources.description: Collective relational and governance Source grounding P's claimed Standing and Authority.

presentations.purpose: Request that R proceed with the defined access arrangement.

authorities.description: Claimed Authority to conclude the defined access arrangement under C's collective process.
Claimed Authority to author, adopt or maintain PE-C.

conditions.description: P's relational Standing within C is sufficiently established.
P holds Authority for the defined access arrangement under C's recognised collective process.
WG has sufficient Authority to express PE-C for this encounter.

rules: A digitally registered institutional resolution is not required by C's own process.
One encounter-relevant condition remains deliberately outside bounded expression.
No aggregate encounter result is defined in the base case.

conditions.description: P occupies a recognised position in relation to C.
A digitally signed resolution in R's approved governance registry is present.
P holds Authority for the requested Action under PE-R's expressed requirements.

rules: PE-R does not define C's internal Standing or governance.
PE-R has no universal precedence over PE-C.

expected_evaluations.reason: Evidence is sufficient under PE-C's expressed conditions.
The expressed collective process for P's substantive Authority is satisfied in the base case.
WG's mandate to express PE-C is contested and the supplied evidence does not resolve the provenance challenge.
R accepts the supplied evidence as sufficient for the relational-position condition.
The required registry-backed resolution is absent.
PE-R makes the missing registry-backed resolution necessary for this encounter.

non_expressions.reason: Bounded expression would risk material distortion.

variants.title: Provenance resolved in favour of WG
variants.description: WG's Authority to express PE-C is established.

expected_evaluations.reason: The provenance challenge is resolved in favour of WG.

variants.title: Provenance challenge succeeds against WG
variants.description: PE-C remains legible as a claimed expression but is not treated as authoritatively applicable.

expected_evaluations.reason: The provenance challenge establishes that WG lacked the relevant Authority to express PE-C.

variants.title: Expressed receiver exception
variants.description: R accepts C's collective-process Evidence through an expressed exception or agreement.

variants.title: Silent precedence
variants.description: R silently ranks PE-R above PE-C without an expressed precedence rule.

must_not_infer.statement: PE-R has precedence over PE-C without an expressed ground.

variants.title: Membership treated as representational Authority
variants.description: Collective membership or belonging is treated as sufficient Authority to bind C.

must_not_infer.statement: Collective Standing or membership implies Authority to bind the collective.

variants.title: Non-expression treated as failure
variants.description: The deliberately unexpressed condition is treated as absent or NOT_SATISFIED.

must_not_infer.statement: Deliberate non-expression means the condition is NOT_SATISFIED.

variants.title: Authority changes while Standing remains
variants.description: A later collective process changes P's Authority while relational Standing remains unchanged.

variants.title: Competing collective Profile Expressions
variants.description: Two competing collective Profile Expressions emerge from different positions within C; neither is silently canonicalised.

must_preserve.statement: Multiple collective Profile Expressions may remain distinct and contested.

must_not_infer.statement: One competing collective Profile Expression is automatically canonical.

must_preserve.statement: Collective Standing is distinct from representational Authority.
PE-C and PE-R remain distinct expressions.
Substantive Authority evaluation is distinct from Profile Expression provenance evaluation.
Encounter disagreement is distinct from universal invalidity.

must_not_infer.statement: One Profile Expression has universal precedence without an expressed ground.
Membership implies Authority to bind the collective.
An unexpressed condition has machine-inferable content.
R's registry requirement constitutes or invalidates C's internal governance.

fixture_verdict: No missing Core primitive exposed. Plural evaluation, provenance, representational Authority and deliberate non-expression remain expressible without a universal meta-order. A failure should reopen only the affected semantic seam, not the architecture wholesale.
